intro: I treat cancers of the digestive system, breast, female reproductive organs, head and neck (including the thyroid), skin and soft tissues. Where it is the right choice for you, I use robotic or keyhole surgery, which means smaller cuts and usually a quicker return to normal life.
treatIntro: Each page explains the condition in plain language: warning signs, tests, treatment options and what recovery looks like.
roboticHeading: Neck surgery without a scar on the neck
roboticText:
Cancers of the mouth, throat and salivary glands often need lymph nodes removed from the neck. The usual operation leaves a long scar across the neck that is visible every day.

**RIA-MIND** (Robotic Infraclavicular Approach for Minimally Invasive Neck Dissection) avoids that scar. The robot works through small cuts below the collarbone, where clothing covers them. Dr. Suraga is a co-author of the 2026 study reporting results of RIA-MIND in 62 patients.

**PRIA** (Parotidectomy by Robotic Infraclavicular Approach) uses the same route below the collarbone to remove tumours of the parotid salivary gland.
aboutText:
Dr. Suraga Belakawadi is a surgical oncologist: a surgeon who specialises in removing cancer. He completed his MCh in Surgical Oncology with a gold medal, after a DNB in General Surgery, and went on to a fellowship in robotic and laparoscopic surgical oncology.

He works as an Attending Consultant at KIMS RENOVA Oncology Institute, Mahadevpura, Bengaluru.

Through [@onco_outreach](https://www.instagram.com/onco_outreach/) on Instagram, he shares short, practical videos on spotting cancer early and understanding treatment.
doctorsText: Share the case on WhatsApp or call directly. Dr. Suraga is glad to discuss whether robotic or minimally invasive surgery suits your patient.
visitNote: Please bring any scans, biopsy reports and previous treatment records to your first visit.
